rules.name: Registry Run Key Modification
rules.description: Detect modification of HKLM/HKCU Run/RunOnce keys
rules.query: SELECT "siem_persistence_persistence_147", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%registry%' AND "value" > 0
